says: When the window's tezgah read finds no process (any person but the founder, since the boot starts only the founder's tezgah), the page says 'Opening' forever, because it never reads the tezgah link's reach.
proof: WindowMachine.ts:1234 sets tezgah reach to missing; main.tsx:33 pickTezgah reads only m.tezgah.client, and main.tsx:223 draws 'Opening' whenever the view is null.
cost: A wrong state word, which 0502 rules out; a person waits on a window that will never open.
